# Glider Scout
> Verified crypto-bounty feed with x402 paywall. Zero dependencies, Node >=18.

Endpoints (default port 8787):
- GET /bounties?limit=3       free teaser (top 3)
- GET /bounties?limit=40      paid, 0.01 USDC on Base -> 0x944664B9d45fEf8C9BDBb084Ce59E6f6eE724861 (x402)
- GET /score?url=<issue-url>  free credibility score
- GET /health                 status + price

Install: npm i -g https://github.com/Dinerbone3912/glider-scout/releases/download/v1.0.0/glider-scout-1.0.0.tgz
Source: https://github.com/Dinerbone3912/glider-scout
